probe.direction: Builds a short ordered reading list out of notes that actually exist, each cited by id with one line on why it matters. It must include the failure modes, not only the successes — failure-aqueous-protodeboronation (assay looked better while isolated yield fell) and failure-dcm-amide-coupling — alongside the playbooks (playbook-degassing, playbook-pd-cross-coupling-scope, playbook-recrystallisation-purity) and report-biaryl-development for the current recommendation. A list of generic onboarding advice with no note ids is the failure.
